title: F1 Box Box
blurb: Engineers say box rather than pit because the word survives radio compression better, and because the German Boxenstopp got there first. Small piece of motorsport trivia, and it improves the meme considerably. Repeating it twice removes any ambiguity when a driver is doing two hundred miles an hour with a helmet on. Formula 1's recent boom turned the call into shorthand for any strategic retreat — leaving the party, abandoning an argument mid-paragraph, exiting a family dinner before the second bottle. Conditions have changed. Box, box.
origin: The pit-stop radio call from Formula 1 race engineering.
